title: Family Group Outside House, 1950s Black & White Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot from around 1950 capturing a multi-generational family standing outside next to a house with a foliage-draped side wall. The group consists of several women, a man in the back, and two young girls in front dressed in mid-century dresses. A vintage automobile is parked along the street in the background. The photo shows minor motion blur on the foliage and a torn bottom corner.
